verdict_reason: One-line constant addition is functionally correct, but HTTP_FORBIDDEN duplicates statusCodes.forbidden from the shared status-codes module.

todos.issue: New HTTP_FORBIDDEN = 403 (line 8) is a second name for a value the repo already names: statusCodes.forbidden: 403 in src/server/common/constants/status-codes.js:7. Its siblings HTTP_NOT_FOUND (line 7, = statusCodes.notFound) and HTTP_CONFLICT (line 9, no shared entry) extend the same parallel table, so 403/404 now have two homes.
todos.fix: Must: each HTTP status code the plants frontend uses has one home, src/server/common/constants/status-codes.js, and the persistence client reads status codes from it. One way: delete HTTP_FORBIDDEN and HTTP_NOT_FOUND from config.js, add conflict: 409 to statusCodes, drop HTTP_CONFLICT, and have get-fulfilment.js and failed.js compare against statusCodes.forbidden / notFound / conflict.
